name: Cabaretti
description: The Cabaretti are one of the five crime families of New Capenna, a party-minded family led by Jetmir and associated with food, celebration and the Halo.

bio.text: The family was said to have figured out how to make Halo and to hold the Font, and Giada, a teenage girl able to turn sewage into pure Halo, was its secret source.

timeline.summary: Xander orders Anhelo to secretly learn about the Cabaretti's rumored new Halo supply in the Mezzio.
timeline.quote: gather the information on what this source is by whatever means necessary.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Ziatora addresses an assembly of workers, attacking the Cabaretti, Brokers and Obscura.
timeline.quote: "The Cabaretti demand too much for this Crescendo without spreading its benefits.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Perrie enters a Mezzio lounge to find Krent and is confronted by two Cabaretti bouncers.
timeline.quote: "If you weren't hassling me, there'd be nothing to disturb your customers about,"

citation.text: "The Contract Breaker" by Tobias S. Buckell. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: The bouncers taunt Perrie as a contract breaker, and he beats both of them.
timeline.quote: "Good kitty," he says softly to the bouncer on his right with a wink.

citation.text: "The Contract Breaker" by Tobias S. Buckell. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: The Adversary, revealed as Ob Nixilis, learns what the Font is and toasts to taking over the plane at the Crescendo.
timeline.quote: "Here's to taking over the plane."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Kamiz confronts Lagrella in an illusory Mergino Fountain, and Lagrella reveals the Prophecy and that the Cabaretti figured out how to make Halo.
timeline.quote: The Cabaretti figured out how to make Halo.

citation.text: "What You Expect to See" by Kaitlyn Zivanovich. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Xander tells Elspeth about the Adversary and the Cabaretti's Font, and orders her to infiltrate the Cabaretti and leave a door unlocked.
timeline.quote: tell me where the Font is kept and leave a door unlocked.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: The Adversary's infiltrators reveal themselves at the Crescendo; revelers throw off their family signets and draw weapons, and the Halo bottle is dropped.
timeline.quote: No family was exempt from infiltration by the Adversary.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Jinnie, Jetmir and Cabaretti emerge and demand Giada be brought to them; Elspeth, sensing Giada's wishes, refuses.
timeline.quote: "Bring Giada to me."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Officers report Jetmir gravely wounded, the Cabaretti neutralized and other families compromised; Ob Nixilis orders the families' heads and a hunt for the Font.
timeline.quote: "I want the families' heads. All of them.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Kitt performs at the Red Room, spotting Ognis and the Riveteers in the audience, and pledges loyalty to the Cabaretti with a song mocking them.
timeline.quote: Pack those vials one by one, up to Park Heights, on the run, bye, bye, boiler

citation.text: "Alley Cat Blues" by Rhiannon Rasmussen. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Jinnie and Cabaretti enforcers storm the warehouse office, disarming Vivien and holding a knife to Elspeth's throat.
timeline.quote: "You didn't really think you could escape us, did you?"

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: The source of the Cabaretti's Halo is revealed to be a single teenage girl, Giada.
timeline.quote: The source of the Cabaretti's Halo turned out to be a single teenage girl.

citation.text: Giada, Font of Hope (Streets of New Capenna Promos, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In Old Capenna the Cabaretti serve as druids; leaving nature, festivals become constant parties.
timeline.quote: During the time of Old Capenna, the Cabaretti served as the plane's druids.

citation.text: "Cabaretti", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rumors spread of a renewable font of halo and an Angel returned in Cabaretti hands.
timeline.quote: Rumors of a new source of halo, a renewable font, threatens the balance of the families.

citation.text: "Cabaretti", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Cabaretti are unmentioned during Atraxa's slaughter, though Jetmir remains active.
timeline.quote: The Cabaretti were conspicuously unmentioned by the defenders of Capenna during Atraxa's slaughter.

citation.text: "Cabaretti", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Discovered by Cabaretti scouts, Giada is found able to turn sewage into pure Halo and the Cabaretti keep her secret.
timeline.quote: she could turn even the foulest city sewage into pure Halo

citation.text: "Giada", section "New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Adversary hoards Halo to monopolize it while the Cabaretti keep it flowing with a new supply unveiled at Crescendo.
timeline.quote: the Cabaretti have kept the Halo flowing through a new supply

citation.text: "Halo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lagrella uses her relationship with Lacey to infiltrate the Cabaretti and steal a sample of Halo.
timeline.quote: She used Lacey to infiltrate the Cabaretti and steal a sample of Halo

citation.text: "Lagrella", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Vanto Beatdown first began at the Vantoleone as an improvised dance-battle.
timeline.quote: The Vanto Beatdown first began here as an improvised dance-battle.

citation.text: "Mezzio", section "Locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion the Obscura, Riveteers and Brokers defend New Capenna in sparse groups while the Cabaretti are absent.
timeline.quote: defended New Capenna in sparse groups
